text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Elm Road, south of Douglas Avenue. The existing accessible parking is no longer required by the original applicant.
North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing accessible parking space on the west side of Elm Road, between a point 21 metres south of Douglas Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further south.
